description.zh-CN: 在 RPEN 中导入 / 编辑 / 导出 Milthm 自制谱（fmt=2）：每条 Milthm 线映射成一条轨道，原生 5 个事件列可切换为 Milthm 语义（X/Y/旋转/线体·线头·整体不透明度/流速倍率/轨道大小），预览按 Milthm 轨道样式与渲染器流速公式绘制，未编辑的谱面导出与源谱 0 diff。RPEN 表达不了的 Milthm 数据（噪域、着色器、GIF、表达式缓动、音符级动画等）原样暂存，导出时提示损失。判定线贴图可自由更换，导出时自动转成图片故事板。渲染面板与视频导出的 HUD 也按 Milthm 样式绘制。
description.en-US: Import, edit and export Milthm fan charts (fmt=2) in RPEN: every Milthm line becomes a track, the five native event columns can be mapped to Milthm semantics (X/Y/rotation/body-head-whole opacity/flow speed/size), and the preview draws Milthm-style tracks with the renderer's speed formula. An untouched chart exports with 0 diff; Milthm data RPEN cannot express (noise areas, shaders, GIF, expression easing, note-level animations...) is preserved as-is and reported as warnings on export. Custom judgement-line textures are exported as picture storyboards. The render panel and exported video use the Milthm HUD as well.

description.zh-CN: 启用时用随模组分发的 ChillRoundF.ttf 覆盖 RPEN 文字：界面/按钮/下拉/输入框等所有 DOM 文本，以及所有用 RPE / RPEGame 字体族的画布文本（时间轴、预览文字、编号等）都会换成这个字体；关闭后恢复 RPEN 自带字体。（ChillRoundF 是第三方 OFL-1.1 字体，不是 PhiEdit 自带字体；许可证与版权声明随包。）
description.en-US: Overrides RPEN text with the bundled ChillRoundF.ttf: all DOM text (buttons, selects, inputs, textareas, kbd, code boxes) and all canvas text that uses the RPE / RPEGame families (timeline, preview text, line numbers). Disable to restore RPEN's own font. (ChillRoundF is a third-party OFL-1.1 font, not PhiEdit's bundled font; license and copyright notice ship with the package.)
